title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-05
ranking_basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains for the 12 primary entries; two newly created repositories appended separately as freshness supplements.
ranking_explanation: Ranks 1-12 are ordered by the stars-today values shown in the GitHub Trending daily view, independently of that page's display order. Ranks 13-14 are not daily-gain ranks: they are newly created, recently active repositories found with GitHub Search, appended in descending current star total. Their daily gains are unavailable and explicitly null/N/A.
global_caveat: Daily star gains are point-in-time values from GitHub Trending. Total-star counts and default-branch commit SHAs were corroborated through GitHub REST where available; later unauthenticated REST reads hit the rate limit for a few repositories, so their totals use the refreshed Trending page or earlier successful API reads. Newly active supplements are not comparable by daily gain. No prior-window evidence was gathered, so no Notable Shifts section is included.

themes.title: Agent context and computer use
themes.summary: Agent systems are gaining richer context and more direct computer interaction: NVIDIA's semantic layer grounds analytics in business definitions, while Vercel's CLI and terminal-mac approach computer use through accessibility trees or a separate virtual macOS guest.

themes.title: Skills and packaged workflows
themes.summary: Reusable skills and explicit engineering roles package agent know-how for installation across tasks and tools; several entries extend this model into creative software or scheduled agent work.

themes.title: Parallel-agent developer infrastructure
themes.summary: Worktrunk simplifies isolated Git worktrees for parallel agents, while Agent Autoloop adds event-driven scheduling, plugin routing, and human approval checkpoints.

themes.title: Automation, data access, and local cloud
themes.summary: Scrapling and the Xianyu monitor automate web data collection; Floci supplies a local AWS-shaped endpoint for development, testing, and CI.

themes.title: Specialist utilities beyond agent tooling
themes.summary: Optical-disc image authoring and voice AI provide distinct non-agent or adjacent-AI signals in the daily set.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-11-05 17:39 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-05 through 2026-11-05. Ranking basis: GitHub Trending daily star gains; two newly created repositories are appended separately as freshness supplements.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent infrastructure dominates today's strongest momentum: NVIDIA's semantic context layer and Vercel's desktop computer-use CLI lead the daily star-gain field. A parallel wave of agent skills and workflow tooling is joined by a few distinct outliers in scraping, local AWS emulation, optical-disc authoring, and voice AI.

sections.title: Top Repositories
sections.content: The first 12 repositories are ranked by daily Trending star gains; the final two are separately labeled newly active supplements with no comparable daily-gain figure.

sections.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
sections.description: A semantic graph and context layer that grounds LLM and agent analytics in enterprise data definitions and provenance.
sections.why_notable: Highest daily gain on the snapshot; its README documents semantic context served to agent harnesses through MCP, CLI, and API.

sections.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
sections.description: A cross-platform computer-use CLI that lets agents inspect and operate apps through native accessibility trees.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain; the observe-by-accessibility-tree approach avoids screenshot and pixel matching loops.

sections.title: mattpocock/skills
sections.description: A collection of small, composable engineering skills for coding agents.
sections.why_notable: One of the day's largest surges; its README emphasizes editable, composable skills designed to work across models and agent tools.

sections.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
sections.description: A Python framework spanning targeted web extraction through full-site crawling.
sections.why_notable: Strong momentum reflects demand for resilient web data collection; the repository also publishes an agent skill and extensive documentation.

sections.title: JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio
sections.description: A cross-platform tool for converting images into visible patterns on recordable CD, DVD, and single-layer Blu-ray discs.
sections.why_notable: A niche but unusually specific hardware-software project among the day's high-gain repositories.
sections.unique_caveat: Immediate disc burning is marked experimental in the README.

sections.title: floci-io/floci
sections.description: A local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.
sections.why_notable: Provides an AWS-shaped local endpoint compatible with common SDK, CLI, and infrastructure workflows.

sections.title: scenario-labs/skills
sections.description: Agent skills for production-ready image, video, audio, and 3D generation, with additional creative-software workflows.
sections.why_notable: Extends agent skills beyond code into multimodal production via Scenario MCP and specialist skills for installed creative applications.
sections.unique_caveat: Most Scenario production skills require Scenario MCP; the expert DCC/game-engine skills require the corresponding software installed locally.

sections.title: garrytan/gstack
sections.description: A role-based coding-agent toolkit spanning product thinking, engineering, review, QA, security, and release.
sections.why_notable: Packages an engineering workflow as explicit agent roles and slash commands.
sections.unique_caveat: Claude Code is the fully certified host; other host integrations have varying maturity.

sections.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
sections.description: A Rust CLI that simplifies Git worktrees for parallel AI-agent tasks.
sections.why_notable: Addresses a practical developer bottleneck as multiple agents work in isolated repositories at once.

sections.title: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
sections.description: A Playwright-and-AI monitoring system for scheduled or real-time Xianyu marketplace listings.
sections.why_notable: A concrete agentic monitoring application rather than a general-purpose agent framework.
sections.unique_caveat: Focused on Xianyu, the Chinese second-hand marketplace.

sections.title: microsoft/VibeVoice
sections.why_notable: Voice generation remains a visible adjacent-AI theme, though its daily gain trails the leading agent tools.

sections.title: google/skills
sections.description: Agent skills for Google products and technologies.
sections.why_notable: A major-vendor entry in the growing skills-as-distribution layer for agents.

sections.title: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
sections.description: A local, plugin-based service that schedules CLI agents, routes events, and asks for human approval only when needed.
sections.why_notable: Created on 2026-11-03 and active today; its event/agent/notification plugins and approval-card loop make it a strong fresh signal. Its current star total is not a daily-gain rank.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says Windows support is not ready; current support is macOS and Linux. Not present on the daily Trending view, so daily star gain is unavailable.

sections.title: govijr/terminal-mac
sections.description: A virtual macOS desktop for computer-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal.
sections.why_notable: Created on 2026-11-03 and active today; it isolates agent computer use in a real macOS guest rather than the host desktop. Its star count is not a daily-gain rank.
sections.unique_caveat: An early release candidate for Apple silicon; the README says live guest acceptance on a clean Mac is still pending. Not present on the daily Trending view, so daily star gain is unavailable.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
Agent context and computer use: NVIDIA/auto-ontology grounds questions in business metadata and lineage; vercel-labs/agent-desktop operates native apps through accessibility APIs; newly active terminal-mac uses a separate virtual Mac. Supporting repositories: repo-01, repo-02, repo-14.
Skills and packaged workflows: mattpocock/skills, google/skills, scenario-labs/skills, and garrytan/gstack turn reusable instructions or role-based procedures into installable agent capabilities. Supporting repositories: repo-03, repo-07, repo-08, repo-12, repo-13.
Parallel-agent developer infrastructure: max-sixty/worktrunk makes isolated worktrees easier, while KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop schedules work, connects event sources, and routes approval requests. Supporting repositories: repo-09, repo-13.
Automation and data access: D4Vinci/Scrapling targets robust web extraction; Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor applies browser automation and AI to marketplace monitoring; floci-io/floci provides local cloud-service emulation for test workflows. Supporting repositories: repo-04, repo-06, repo-10.
Specialist utilities: Disc Image Studio and VibeVoice are distinct optical-media and voice-AI signals. Supporting repositories: repo-05, repo-11.
Languages: Among the 12 daily Trending entries, Python leads with 6, Rust has 2, and Shell, TypeScript, C#, and Java have 1 each. Fresh supplements add TypeScript and Swift.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today's strongest signal is the tooling layer around agents: reliable context, native computer interaction, reusable skills, and infrastructure for parallel or unattended work. The fresh-repository search reinforces that pattern with Agent Autoloop, while the daily Trending list also shows room for specialized projects such as disc authoring and local cloud emulation. Daily star-gain figures apply only to GitHub Trending entries; the two fresh additions are separate discovery signals, not comparable daily-gain ranks.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, refreshed at 2026-11-05 17:38 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository and default-branch commit endpoints; GitHub Search API query for repositories created and pushed from 2026-11-03 through 2026-11-05 with more than 50 stars, sorted by stars. README content checked for principal momentum signals and both fresh additions. Daily Trending entries are ordered by displayed stars-today values. Two fresh-search supplements are appended separately with null daily gains. Some late REST calls hit GitHub's unauthenticated rate limit; their totals are from the refreshed Trending page or earlier successful API reads.
